instruction: From the command line, rotate tilearray.png clockwise by 90 degrees and store the new file as 'rotated.png' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires rotating tilearray.png (962x1280) 90 degrees clockwise. After rotation, dimensions should be swapped to 1280x962. Verified with Python: original is 962x1280, after 90-degree rotation becomes 1280x962.
